model.bx: system-ui fontBoundingBox [asc,desc] at 5/6/7 (spot overrides where jsround(px*ratio) misses)
model.kern: per-font pair table, px at 100px (2dp floats; runtime ints = round(px*100)); kern(px) = v*px/10000 exactly for fixed fonts (measured 8..32)
model.kk_magnet: pairs kept when |kern@100|>0.05px OR optical knots deviate >0.0005em (r5 full sweep 16/20/24/100 over ascii+210 ext, both orders + ext*ext); sub-threshold pairs unmodeled <=0.05px/pair
model.su_optical: system-ui kern: knots kk=[em@16,em@20,em@24] (1e-4em); em flat <=16, blends 16->28, >=28 exactly linear; GPOS device-table bands kb (px*100 at integer sizes 6..23) for every pair with kern or optical knots (full re-capture r6a); band wins below 24; px<=6 clamps to B[0]*px/600
model.triples: tri(abc)=w(abc)-w(ab)-w(bc)+w(b), px@100; coverage: full ascii 95^3 for the 4 script fonts (Marker Felt/Zapfino/Hoefler Text/Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN) + one-sided full-charset (ascii+210 ext) over every kerned pair for all 69 fonts (r6f, 16.2M measures) + ligature chains X+ff/fi/fl and ff/fi/fl+X for 49 lig fonts; non-su fonts exactly linear in px (r6g residual <=0.001); su triples (7063, zero ascii-letter, exotic punct chains only) linear px@100 with optical residual <=0.47px at 16, converging >=28
